bandReport.notes: All four assigned pages (10, 11, 12, 13) opened and read; no page was empty. Items 47-64, none skipped, none duplicated. BOUNDARIES: page 10 opens with item 47 whole at the top of column 1, so nothing continues in from page 9 (band b2's territory). Page 13 ends with item 64 whole - its option (d) 'Lalitavistara' is the last printed line of column 2 - so item 65 must begin on page 14 (the next band's territory); I did not open page 14. CROPS: the gutter was detected on all four pages and every c1/c2 crop was clean. Each c1 crop carries a narrow sliver of the right column's item numbers at its right edge ('49.'/'50.' on p10, '53.'/'54.' on p11, '57.'/'58.' on p12, '61.'/'62.'/'63.'/'64.' on p13) and each c2 crop carries the page-footer fragment '- A )'; both are the expected overlap, not a slice. No page had to be read from pNN.png. TABLES: items 47 and 55 print genuine data grids, transcribed as GFM pipe tables. Both grids print an UNLABELLED first column holding the serial numbers 1.-4., so the header row of each table has an empty leading cell - preserved as printed rather than invented a heading. LAYOUT/EMPHASIS: in items 51 and 52 the word 'not' in option (b) is set in bold italic in the booklet; transcribed as plain text since it is typographic emphasis, not content. Item titles in options of 63 and 64 are printed in italics (work titles) - likewise plain. VERBATIM ODDITY (flagged, NOT corrected): item 57's stem frames the question as 'With reference to revenue collection by Cornwallis' and then statement 1 asks about the Ryotwari Settlement, which is not associated with Cornwallis. Transcribed exactly as printed; this reads as the question's own design rather than a misprint, but a later reader should know it is on the page that way. No other printed defects: no duplicate option texts, no blank or missing option labels, no unreadable text, no gaps in the item numbering. SUBTOPIC WARNINGS (soft field, not in catalog.json): item 50 uses 'Corporate Social Responsibility' and item 59 uses 'International Commodity Organizations' - nothing listed fitted; both subjects and chapters are copied exactly from the catalog.
